entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I'm just so disappointed. I bought a new Aero Race Jersey a few weeks ago, and it's just not right.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, could I get your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-0215. I was so excited for this jersey, I saved up for it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this is the first time I've had a problem.

Thank you, I've pulled up your order. I see the Aero Race Jersey, delivered about 27 days ago. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just the wrong size. I followed the size chart, but it's incredibly tight. I can barely zip it up. I feel terrible about it, but I really can't wear it and I was hoping I could get my money back.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial for performance gear. Let me just check our return policy for you... one moment.
Oh, I really hope so. With the holidays just finishing, I could really use the refund.
Okay, I've confirmed it. You're well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a return for a full refund for that jersey.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, David. You've honestly made my day.
You're very welcome. I can also process an exchange if you'd just like to get the correct size. Would you prefer a refund or an exchange for a larger jersey?
You know, since it was so much tighter than expected, I think I'll just take the refund for now and re-evaluate the sizing later. Thank you for offering the exchange, though.

Not a problem at all. I have just initiated the return process for a full refund. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
